author: enumeration_review
claims: Alternating groups on supports overlapping in at least two points generate the full alternating group of their union.
For any transitive H on X, |X|>=5, adjoining (i u)(v w),(u v)(w z) generates the full alternating or symmetric group according to H parity.
A single twist by a commuting external involution gives abstract H or HxC2; absence of that involution from the twisted group gives an exact marked isomorphism and IP equivalence.

source_rows.status: complete elementary reproof of borrowed group-generation interface
complete elementary reproof with tau-not-in-twisted-group condition for IP preserved

exclusions: No claim that the four-point attachment preserves IP.
